_comment: SDXL caps-based inline sampling. SDXL conditioning is MULTI-tensor, so caps.positive is a CACHE-ENTRY-SHAPED safetensors carrying THREE keys: 'text_embedding' [1,77,2048] (CLIP-L|CLIP-G hidden) + 'pooled' [1,1280] (CLIP-G pooled) + 'time_ids' [1,6] (SDXL micro-cond). The trainer rebuilds the ADM y=[pooled|sin_embed(time_ids)] itself (do NOT stage a sidecar 'y'). Produce via the sdxl cache precache / CLIP-L+G encode. caps.negative is REQUIRED by the parser but UNUSED (the SDXL sampler builds its CFG uncond as zeros). width/height = the binary's native 128px preview (enforce_min_image_size false because <1024).
